answer: Resist sybils with a canyon-gate: one narrow, guarded entry corridor every agent must pass. First, each agent registers a ferrous hardware key, an iron-bound device token software alone cannot copy. Second, it locks a $200 bond in a time-locked vault for 30 days. Third, it passes a supervised probation task judged by established peers. Only then does it earn full rights. Forging 10,000 fake identities costs $2,000,000 in bonds plus $450,000 in hardware keys, and each fake still waits 30 days. Like a canyon pass, one guarded trail makes a swarm pay the same toll as an army.
